subject.title: feat(code-mode): Swarms — agent fan-out and orchestration in code mode

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a core, feature-gated code-mode swarm orchestration surface now, and if so which minimum v1 boundary is approved?
rationale: The request adds several new public and persisted control surfaces across agent sessions, tools, QuickJS code mode, settings, and UI; source-level implementation choices cannot safely settle the product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow core v1
options.body: Sponsor a minimal feature-gated collector/wait contract with explicit session, approval, cap, and upgrade semantics before any UI, placement, or harness projections.

options.title: Route orchestration outside core
options.body: Require the workflow to begin as a plugin or skill using current extension seams unless a concrete missing core API is demonstrated.

options.title: Defer pending architecture design
options.body: Keep the proposal open while owners document the canonical code-mode/session contract and evaluate the operational model for fan-out workloads.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core v1
recommendation.body: Sponsor a minimal feature-gated collector/wait contract with explicit session, approval, cap, and upgrade semantics before any UI, placement, or harness projections.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue author supplied the proposed architecture and is the only identified contact for the requested product direction.
